summary: Search for a 21-year-old woman missing since the previous afternoon near Mosca Pass in Great Sand Dunes National Park; last cell-phone contact near Mosca Pass suggested she was becoming disoriented. AVSAR assisted NPS and was requested for the Huerfano County side; she was located uninjured in Huerfano County by a Huerfano County firefighter and walked back to her car.
location: Mosca Pass area, Great Sand Dunes National Park
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR (assist to National Park Service)
notes: Subject from Minnesota; had seen a mountain lion and lost the trail trying to distance herself.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Huerfano County, Colorado, United States)
